event_summary: A pink rectangular block is lowered onto the blue top block of a small three-block structure and remains upright after the holder withdraws.
raw_event_description: A small structure on a wooden tabletop consists of a blue horizontal rectangular block spanning between a red vertical block on the left and a yellow vertical block on the right. A pink rectangular block appears from above, held at its upper end by a dark object with blue edges, descends while slightly angled, approaches the top of the blue block, then its lower end meets the blue block. The pink block becomes nearly vertical on the blue block. The dark holder moves upward and out of view, leaving the pink block standing on top of the blue block. The red, yellow, and blue blocks remain visibly in place.

reasons: The tabletop block structure is fully visible.
The pink block is only partially visible near the top edge of the frame.
The dark holder is not fully visible in the first frame.
